title: IP Find for Chrome
subtitle: Network IP Discovery Tool
description: One click and Chrome tells you your IP. A whole extension for something you could search for; in my defence, it is faster.
longDescription: A Chrome extension that quickly identifies and displays the current network's IP address. This tool is useful for network diagnostics and understanding your current network configuration.
why: "What's my IP?" comes back every time you switch VPN or Wi-Fi, usually with "and where does it think I am?" IP Find answers both from a toolbar popup and looks up any other address too. It asks for the clipboard and nothing else, so it couldn't read your pages even if it wanted to.
